content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the district court of utena the court decided to dissolve a marriage and divide the matrimonial property the applicant was awarded a vw car while the defendant was awarded an audi car the applicant also requested the annulment of the marriage restoration of their premarital name and maintenance for their child the defendant did not respond to the application and the court upheld the applicants claims the court ordered the defendant to pay the applicants legal costs and maintenance for the child the court also ordered the division of property and assigned a car to each party the defendant is responsible for paying a total of €860 including professional fees and stamp duty
